design.a3: floor binding < 20% on the gated population at the 50% arm, PER SYMBOL, never pooled (§4.4)
design.firewall: entry-time quantities only: binding rates, pass rates, signal counts, ATR percentiles. Layer B is never run.
design.grid: 11 points, m* to m*+2.5 step 0.25; the range is NOT extended (§4.3)
design.population: breakout bars in the training fold: Donchian-20 + EMA20/EMA50, BEFORE the RVOL gate (Appendix F.1)
design.rvol_thresholds: pass rates (0.3, 0.5, 0.7) on breakout bars; baseline_days fixed at 20 (§4.3)
design.stop_max_pct: (m* + 2.5) x P95(ATR%) over the same population (Appendix H / Amendment 6, superseding the median form)
